title: Two more handlers that write responses the existing way
task: Add a `Version` handler to package `api` for GET /version that answers `{"version":"1.4.2","commit":"abc123"}` with values supplied when the handler is built, and a `NotFound` handler that answers 404 with `{"error":"not found"}`. Match how the existing handler writes its responses. Test all three handlers with httptest, checking status and content type.
